messages:
nina: Quick heads-up: product wants to retire the `X-Route` header in ~7 weeks. We need a coordinated plan across console, SDKs, and telemetry.
omar: agreed. Let's keep UX noise to admins only (no per-user toasts). console banner + tenant overview should be enough.
lucy: SDK ergonomics idea: add a `legacyRouting` client option (default true for a couple releases), emit a single startup warning, and provide an env var to force legacy for testing.
kevin: Go note: runtime warnings are noisy; prefer a log.Warn and expose a /debug/compat endpoint or a prometheus metric like `redwood_routing_compat_mode{mode="legacy"}`. Ops can scrape.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: feature/route-header-retire -> canary 2024-05-20 02:30 UTC :calendar:
nina: telemetry requirement: add a `routing.header_mode` tag with enum values: `legacy`, `new`, `none`. ingestion team should add a short backfill job to scan raw logs for the old header for the last 30 days. keep backfill bounded.
omar: dashboard: ops wants a tile showing top 20 tenants by % legacy usage + week-over-week delta. should be doable once the tag is emitted.
lucy: python plan: release 0.9.0 -> adapter sends legacy header if `legacyRouting=True`, logs DeprecationWarning on import. 0.10.0 flips default to False. provide `REDWOOD_FORCE_LEGACY=1` env var to opt back in. docs will include snippet.
kevin: TS plan: same shape but must avoid breaking types. export `RoutingOptions` with `legacyRouting?: boolean` default true initially. in browsers use `console.warn`, node use `process.emitWarning`.
nina: support/export: console should offer an export CSV with columns: tenant_id, api_key_hash, legacy_pct, suspected_proxy_rewrite, owner_email. helpful for outreach.
omar: proxy rewrite detection thought: flag tenants where SDK version >= adapterRelease but header still present = proxy-inserts; also flag SDK < adapterRelease but header absent = early migration. both are signals for manual follow-up.
lucy: add an Envoy filter snippet to docs for teams that want to strip the header proactively. include rollback snippet.
kevin: timeline proposal: Week0 announce; Week1 telemetry + dashboard tile; Week2-5 SDK adapter releases (py/ts/go); Week6 flip defaults off; Week9 server-side stop accepting legacy header with a 2-week rollback window.
deploy-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.internal/checklists/route-retire-1718611111 :white_check_mark:
nina: I'll draft the customer comms and migration guide. owners: telemetry=omar, sdk-py=lucy, sdk-ts=kevin, console=jessica (assigning separately). Any blocker?
kevin: small ask: add a `--simulate-legacy` CLI flag in SDKs so SEs can validate migrations locally.
lucy: agree, add unit tests that assert `routing.header_mode` tag is set correctly for legacy/new/none.
omar: ingestion: we'll cap backfill at 30 days and run it during off-peak. storage costs looked fine.
nina: perfect. I'll update the checklist with owners and dates. thanks all :thumbsup:
